svg.aria-label: F14: k_thread_abort() makes a joiner ready and does not reschedule (CONFIG_USE_SWITCH=y)

g.data-tip: t3 (preemptible): thread priority 0.
g.title: t3 (preemptible): thread priority 0.

g.data-tip: Same thread priority (1): t1 (preemptible), t2 (preemptible). These contexts cannot preempt each other. A pending one waits until the running one ends or blocks.
g.title: Same thread priority (1): t1 (preemptible), t2 (preemptible). These contexts cannot preempt each other. A pending one waits until the running one ends or blocks.

g.data-tip: t3 (preemptible): t3 runs. t3 runs its own code in thread mode.
g.title: t3 (preemptible): t3 runs. t3 runs its own code in thread mode.

g.data-tip: t3 (preemptible): k_thread_join(t2). Step 1 of the TLC trace (state 1 -> 2). z_impl_k_thread_join(t2, K_FOREVER) (thread.c:1782): z_sched_spinlock_lock() (thread.c:1784). k_spin_lock() raises BASEPRI (spinlock.h:204, asm_inline_gcc.h:56-57). t2 is not dead, the timeout is not K_NO_WAIT, no deadlock: z_sched_add_to_waitq_locked(_current, &t2->join_queue) (thread.c:1799) -> unready_thread(): update_cache(thread == _current) = update_cache(1) (sched.c:247). update_cache(1) (sched.c:161): preempt_ok = 1, so should_preempt() returns true at once (kthread.h:248-249). cache = next_up() = head of the run queue = t1 (sched.c:173). The function does not call z_pend_curr() (no ISR check, finding F4).
g.title: t3 (preemptible): k_thread_join(t2). Step 1 of the TLC trace (state 1 -> 2). z_impl_k_thread_join(t2, K_FOREVER) (thread.c:1782): z_sched_spinlock_lock() (thread.c:1784). k_spin_lock() raises BASEPRI (spinlock.h:204, asm_inline_gcc.h:56-57). t2 is not dead, the timeout is not K_NO_WAIT, no deadlock: z_sched_add_to_waitq_locked(_current, &t2->join_queue) (thread.c:1799) -> unready_thread(): update_cache(thread == _current) = update_cache(1) (sched.c:247). update_cache(1) (sched.c:161): preempt_ok = 1, so should_preempt() returns true at once (kthread.h:248-249). cache = next_up() = head of the run queue = t1 (sched.c:173). The function does not call z_pend_curr() (no ISR check, finding F4).

g.data-tip: t3 (preemptible): z_swap(): switch. z_swap_locked(key) (thread.c:1803, kswap.h:234) -> do_swap() (kswap.h:183, kswap.h:79): new thread = _kernel.ready_q.cache = t1 (kswap.h:112), arch_switch() (kswap.h:162) = arm_m_switch() (arm-m-switch.h:220). The new thread sets BASEPRI 0 after the stack switch (arm-m-switch.h:307).
g.title: t3 (preemptible): z_swap(): switch. z_swap_locked(key) (thread.c:1803, kswap.h:234) -> do_swap() (kswap.h:183, kswap.h:79): new thread = _kernel.ready_q.cache = t1 (kswap.h:112), arch_switch() (kswap.h:162) = arm_m_switch() (arm-m-switch.h:220). The new thread sets BASEPRI 0 after the stack switch (arm-m-switch.h:307).

g.data-tip: t1 (preemptible): k_thread_abort(t2). Step 2 of the TLC trace (state 2 -> 3). The generic z_impl_k_thread_abort() (thread.c:1770). z_thread_abort() (thread.c:1751): z_sched_spinlock_lock() (thread.c:1754). k_spin_lock() raises BASEPRI (spinlock.h:204, asm_inline_gcc.h:56-57). z_thread_halt() (thread.c:1761, sched.c:299) -> halt_thread() (sched.c:349, sched.c:858): t2 is dead and leaves the run queue (sched.c:868-869). unpend_all(&t2->join_queue) (sched.c:899, sched.c:828): t3 ready with the return value 0 (sched.c:836, sched.c:841).
g.title: t1 (preemptible): k_thread_abort(t2). Step 2 of the TLC trace (state 2 -> 3). The generic z_impl_k_thread_abort() (thread.c:1770). z_thread_abort() (thread.c:1751): z_sched_spinlock_lock() (thread.c:1754). k_spin_lock() raises BASEPRI (spinlock.h:204, asm_inline_gcc.h:56-57). z_thread_halt() (thread.c:1761, sched.c:299) -> halt_thread() (sched.c:349, sched.c:858): t2 is dead and leaves the run queue (sched.c:868-869). unpend_all(&t2->join_queue) (sched.c:899, sched.c:828): t3 ready with the return value 0 (sched.c:836, sched.c:841).

g.data-tip: t1 (preemptible): update_cache(1). halt_thread() calls update_cache(1) for each target (sched.c:914), also when the target is not _current. update_cache(1) (sched.c:161): preempt_ok = 1, so should_preempt() returns true at once (kthread.h:248-249). cache = next_up() = head of the run queue = t3 (sched.c:173).
g.title: t1 (preemptible): update_cache(1). halt_thread() calls update_cache(1) for each target (sched.c:914), also when the target is not _current. update_cache(1) (sched.c:161): preempt_ok = 1, so should_preempt() returns true at once (kthread.h:248-249). cache = next_up() = head of the run queue = t3 (sched.c:173).

g.data-tip: t1 (preemptible): spin unlock. t2 is not _current: z_thread_halt() ends with z_sched_spinlock_unlock(key) (sched.c:359). k_spin_unlock() writes the key back to BASEPRI (spinlock.h:346, asm_inline_gcc.h:89). No reschedule: the cache (t3) stays as it is until the next reschedule point.
g.title: t1 (preemptible): spin unlock. t2 is not _current: z_thread_halt() ends with z_sched_spinlock_unlock(key) (sched.c:359). k_spin_unlock() writes the key back to BASEPRI (spinlock.h:346, asm_inline_gcc.h:89). No reschedule: the cache (t3) stays as it is until the next reschedule point.
